title: report_list
description: The signed-in user's own Snap reports (photos and no-bin reports; scan frames are left out), newest received first, from GET /me/reports?limit=&cursor=. Read from the reports by-user GSI, so only rows whose user_id is the token's sub. Each item is exactly the GET /reports/{id} response for that report. Guest reports made before accounts have no user_id and never appear.

reports.description: At most limit items (20 by default, at most 50). A page can hold fewer than limit while next_cursor is not null; keep paging until it is null. report, moderation and verification are the report_upload, moderation_result and verification_result bodies; validate them against those schemas (schemas here never reference each other).

status.description: needs_confirmation and not_confirmed since contracts v1.16: the judge was unsure and the reporter is asked, or did not answer in time.

confirmation.description: Contracts v1.16: null unless the verify step asked the reporter; as in the GET /reports/{id} response. Not in required, so v1.14 producers stay valid.

updated_at.description: The row's last change; the app keeps it as the item's freshness token.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass it back as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page. A cursor only opens the user who received it.
